attempts.hypothesis: Instruction count is approximately an additive function of new, cached, and finished request counts, with additional fixed overhead for refreshing metadata when batch membership changes.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks request-state construction and insertion into the persistent batch.

pcvs.name: cached_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks the per-request loop updating running and resumed requests.

pcvs.name: finished_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks cached-state cleanup and persistent-batch removal.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed metadata-refresh overhead when batch membership changes.

attempts.hypothesis: Work proportional to refreshed batch size and row relocation explains variation missed by raw request counts and a batch-change indicator.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks construction and insertion of new request states.

pcvs.name: cached_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks updates to existing requests.

pcvs.expression: len(scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs) + len(scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.req_ids) if scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs or scheduler_output.finished_req_ids or scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids else 0
pcvs.name: refreshed_batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Metadata reconstruction after membership changes scales with the resulting batch size.

pcvs.expression: sum((1 for req_id in self.input_batch.req_id_to_index if req_id not in scheduler_output.finished_req_ids and req_id in scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens and (req_id not in scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids) and (self.input_batch.req_id_to_index[req_id] >= len(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens))))
pcvs.name: condensed_rows
pcvs.rationale: Counts surviving rows beyond the final batch boundary that require relocation during condensation.

attempts.hypothesis: Request counts and membership changes omit prompt-length-dependent metadata construction. The padded prompt matrix size should explain additional work, especially for longer prompts and batches using repetition penalties.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks request construction, sampling setup, and persistent-batch insertion.

pcvs.name: cached_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks ordinary updates to running requests.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed costs of rebuilding sampling metadata after membership changes.

pcvs.expression: len(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens) * max([0] + [len(req.prompt_token_ids) if req.prompt_token_ids is not None else 0 for req in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs] + [self.requests[req_id].num_prompt_tokens for req_id in scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.req_ids]) if scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs or scheduler_output.finished_req_ids or scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids else 0
pcvs.name: refreshed_prompt_elements
pcvs.rationale: Estimates the padded prompt-token matrix rebuilt for sampling metadata; captures both batch size and prompt length.

attempts.hypothesis: Prompt matrix size did not improve the model. New-request costs depend on seeded generator construction, while metadata reconstruction has both fixed and per-row costs.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks request creation and insertion costs.

pcvs.expression: sum((1 for req in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs if req.sampling_params is not None and req.sampling_params.sampling_type == SamplingType.RANDOM_SEED))
pcvs.name: seeded_new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Separates requests that construct and seed a torch.Generator.

pcvs.expression: len(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens) if scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs or scheduler_output.finished_req_ids or scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids else 0
pcvs.name: refreshed_batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Tracks per-row sampling metadata reconstruction following membership changes.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Separates fixed metadata reconstruction overhead from its per-row cost.

attempts.hypothesis: Fit fixed refresh overhead, per-row refresh work, and condensation together. Earlier candidates omitted either the fixed refresh term or condensation while including these other costs.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks request construction and insertion.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed metadata reconstruction overhead.

pcvs.expression: len(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens) if scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs or scheduler_output.finished_req_ids or scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids else 0
pcvs.name: refreshed_batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Captures metadata reconstruction work proportional to the resulting batch size.

pcvs.expression: sum((1 for req_id in self.input_batch.req_id_to_index if req_id not in scheduler_output.finished_req_ids and req_id in scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens and (req_id not in scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids) and (self.input_batch.req_id_to_index[req_id] >= len(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens))))
pcvs.name: condensed_rows
pcvs.rationale: Tracks surviving rows that must move to fill holes left by removals.

attempts.hypothesis: Entry batch size and sampling composition may explain costs that final batch size and condensation counts miss. Random-sampling metadata work varies independently of total request count as requests finish.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks request construction and insertion.

pcvs.name: entry_batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Measures the persistent batch before removals, including rows inspected and reorganized.

pcvs.name: finished_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks state cleanup and removal work.

pcvs.expression: int(bool(scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs) or bool(scheduler_output.finished_req_ids)) * (sum((1 for req in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs if req.sampling_params is not None and req.sampling_params.temperature > 0)) + sum((1 for req_id in scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.req_ids if self.requests[req_id].sampling_params is not None and self.requests[req_id].sampling_params.temperature > 0)))
pcvs.name: random_sampling_refresh
pcvs.rationale: Tracks random-sampling requests participating in metadata reconstruction, distinguishing batches with different temperature and sampling requirements.

attempts.hypothesis: Variation among similarly sized decode batches may arise from block-table updates at allocation boundaries. Counting non-None cached block updates distinguishes these paths from ordinary request updates.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks new request creation and batch insertion.

pcvs.name: cached_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks ordinary running-request updates.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Captures metadata reconstruction following membership changes.

pcvs.expression: sum((1 for block_ids in scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.new_block_ids if block_ids is not None))
pcvs.name: cached_block_table_updates
pcvs.rationale: Counts cached requests taking the additional block-extension and persistent block-table append paths.

attempts.hypothesis: Cached block updates were always absent. Penalty-enabled request counts may instead explain metadata work that varies independently of batch size; ungated prompt matrix size did not isolate this branch.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks request construction and insertion.

pcvs.name: cached_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks updates to running requests.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed metadata reconstruction overhead.

pcvs.expression: sum((1 for req in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs if req.sampling_params is not None and (req.sampling_params.presence_penalty != 0 or req.sampling_params.frequency_penalty != 0 or req.sampling_params.repetition_penalty != 1))) + sum((1 for req_id in scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.req_ids if self.requests[req_id].sampling_params is not None and (self.requests[req_id].sampling_params.presence_penalty != 0 or self.requests[req_id].sampling_params.frequency_penalty != 0 or self.requests[req_id].sampling_params.repetition_penalty != 1))) if scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs or scheduler_output.finished_req_ids or scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids else 0
pcvs.name: penalized_refresh_rows
pcvs.rationale: Counts requests requiring penalty-related prompt and output-token metadata during refresh.

attempts.hypothesis: Admission batches may have a distinct fixed cost that a shared batch-change indicator misses. Separate admission setup and per-request work, while modeling removal-only calls through refreshed survivors and row-maintenance operations.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks per-request admission work.

pcvs.name: has_new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Separates fixed setup for admitting requests from ordinary removal-only metadata refresh.

pcvs.expression: len(scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.req_ids) if scheduler_output.finished_req_ids or scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs or scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids else 0
pcvs.name: refreshed_cached_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks surviving requests whose metadata is rebuilt after membership changes.

pcvs.expression: len(scheduler_output.finished_req_ids) + sum((1 for req_id in self.input_batch.req_id_to_index if req_id not in scheduler_output.finished_req_ids and req_id in scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens and (req_id not in scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs.resumed_req_ids) and (self.input_batch.req_id_to_index[req_id] >= len(scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens))))
pcvs.name: removed_and_relocated_rows
pcvs.rationale: Counts row removals and subsequent relocations as batch-maintenance operations.

attempts.hypothesis: The empty-cache admission remains the worst-explained observation across candidates. An explicit empty-cache indicator tests whether initial setup incurs an additional fixed cost beyond ordinary request admission and metadata refresh.

pcvs.name: new_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks per-request construction and insertion.

pcvs.name: cached_requests
pcvs.rationale: Tracks updates to existing requests.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Separates metadata reconstruction from unchanged-batch updates.

pcvs.name: empty_request_cache
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes entry with no initialized request state, when initial batch setup and lazy initialization may add fixed work.
